decks.notes: This deck aims to use the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach to quickly fill the graveyard with key spells and then cast them repeatedly from the graveyard. By utilizing various card draw, tutors, and powerful mana rocks, the deck is able to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion options. The deck focuses on using its resources wisely to establish a dominant board state and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful combo potential.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of artifact creatures and powerful artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes mana acceleration from various artifacts like Moxen and Mana Crypt to quickly cast threats like Scrawling Crawler and Glaring Fleshraker. The deck also includes cards like Mystic Forge, Karn, the Great Creator, and The One Ring to provide additional card advantage and utility. With a strong mana base including Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy, the deck aims to rapidly deploy threats and disrupt opponents' game plan while maintaining a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's strategies by playing hatebears with disruptive abilities like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex while utilizing powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Chrome Mox to accelerate its game plan. The deck aims to control the game through cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere, creating a challenging environment for the opponent to navigate. Additionally, cards like Clarion Conqueror and Seasoned Dungeoneer provide card advantage and board presence to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main strategy of this deck is to utilize control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantage through efficient card draw and resource management. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value to be gained from the graveyard, providing a consistent source of card advantage and recursion. By efficiently controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent, this UW Control deck aims to grind out incremental advantages and ultimately secure victory through careful resource management and strategic play.

Strong control elements combined with efficient removal and disruption create a powerful strategy that aims to control the game's pace and outvalue the opponent in card advantage and resource management. This deck seeks to generate incremental advantages while disrupting the opponent's game plan, eventually overwhelming them with superior card quality and board control. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion further enhances the deck's ability to recur key threats and keep up the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog and Orcish Bowmasters. It leverages powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Time Walk to gain card advantage and accelerate its game plan. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional card advantage and recursion of key pieces. The deck also includes disruptive artifacts like Null Rod to disrupt opponents' game plans. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using various efficient spells and powerful artifacts to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, as well as powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Gifts Ungiven. The deck also utilizes powerful mana acceleration with the inclusion of the Moxen and sol lands like Tolarian Academy. Additionally, the deck has access to powerful combo potential with Brain Freeze and Underworld Breach. Overall, this deck aims to control the game and win through incremental advantage and powerful combo finishes.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful artifact-based engine to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. By utilizing fast mana sources like Moxen and Mana Crypt, along with powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Mystic Forge, the deck aims to generate massive advantage and put pressure on opponents early in the game. Key cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Manifold Key help unlock additional combo potential, while creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Patchwork Automaton provide a solid beatdown plan. Overall, the deck aims to play fast and disrupt opponents to secure a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing fast mana rocks and card draw, along with the "Paradoxical Outcome" card, to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage quickly. The goal is to set up a powerful combo turn, drawing many cards and generating mana through the deck's artifact and land base to either win the game outright or set up a strong advantage. By using cards like "Lórien Revealed", "Mental Misstep", and "Force of Will" to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to win the game in a quick and explosive fashion.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key cards like Stinkweed Imp, Narcomoeba, and Golgari Thug. By dredging cards into the graveyard, the deck can quickly bring back Prized Amalgam and Ichorid to create a strong board presence. Noxious Revival and Grief help disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Shambling Shell and Creeping Chill provide additional value. With powerful cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Force of Will to support its combo strategy, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless graveyard-based game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while assembling a strong board presence through efficient and disruptive creatures like Deathrite Shaman, Collector Ouphe, and Leovold, Emissary of Trest. The deck also aims to control the game with counterspells like Force of Will and disruption spells like Abrupt Decay and Assassin's Trophy. Additionally, the deck includes powerful card advantage and selection spells like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm to ensure consistent draws and keep up with the opponent. The overall strategy is to apply constant pressure and disruption to win the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's plans while quickly establishing a board presence. By utilizing cards like Wasteland, Chancellor of the Annex, and Archon of Emeria, it aims to slow down the opponent's mana development and spell casting. Anointed Peacekeeper and Clarion Conqueror provide additional disruption and control options. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer, White Plume Adventurer, and Witch Enchanter to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of fast mana sources like Moxen and Ancient Tomb allows for explosive starts and efficient use of resources.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through the use of powerful artifacts and spells like Moxen, Black Lotus, and Mana Crypt. This enables the player to cast spells like Paradoxical Outcome, which allows them to draw more cards and recast their artifacts to continue generating mana and card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect itself and control the opponent's board. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful board state and win the game through a combination of card advantage and overwhelming tempo.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hatebears like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer. It also includes disruptive cards like Strip Mine, Wasteland, and Chalice of the Void to control the board. The deck utilizes mana acceleration through Moxen and Ancient Tomb to quickly deploy threats. The presence of protection cards like Solitude and Clarion Conqueror ensures the deck can handle threats efficiently. The inclusion of Cavern of Souls and Karakas provides additional protection and utility against opposing strategies.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Anointed Peacekeeper. It aims to slow down the opponent's strategy and prevent them from casting spells efficiently, while also building a board presence to close out the game quickly. The mana base is designed to support a fast start, with mana acceleration from artifacts like Moxen and Ancient Tomb, while also providing disruption with cards like Wasteland and Karakas.

The deck focuses on early mana acceleration and establishing a strong board presence quickly through aggressive artifact creatures like Grim Monolith, Patchwork Automaton, and Glaring Fleshraker. The key strategy involves using cards like Manifold Key and Karn, the Great Creator to unlock powerful synergies with artifacts like Time Vault and Mystic Forge. The deck also utilizes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Lodestone Golem to control the opponent's plays. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive aggro strategy centered around artifact creatures and powerful artifact synergies.
